fieldValues.title: Real relations already fall into declared strata, and the mess is three axes drawn as one
fieldValues.summary: Against five declared strata, every rests-on relation inside a real meeting goes down or stays level; the only upward ones cross meetings and 89 go to standing records, so depth, time and standing are separate directions.
evidence: Master with two meetings, 2026-11-27: 600 rests-on relations: 209 one down, 180 skip one, 110 within a stratum, 89 to standing records, 7 back to an earlier meeting; 250 arrangement
srs-lab minutes/strata.py and the page it writes
fieldValues.body: A drill-down that offers down, back, across and around separately is not a graph. 110 relations within one stratum suggest a layer is missing or that a stratum needs an order.
